0022600001.text: Both the Detroit Pistons and Boston Celtics are opening their 2026-27 seasons, with Detroit hosting. Taurean Prince is out for the Pistons for personal reasons, and Devin Carter is out for Boston due to illness. In 2025-26, the Pistons won the season series 3-1, including a 104-103 victory over Boston in Detroit on January 19, 2026.
